title: {enemy:shieldbearer}
text:
{item:warding_charm}每秒给它叠一层护甲（{item_stat:warding_charm:max_armor} 点，一直叠、没有上限），用剑砍只是在砍盾。

毒不看护甲：{item:poisoned_knife}扎进去，它的盾再厚也一样掉血。

texts.en:
Its {item:warding_charm} stacks Armor on it every second ({item_stat:warding_charm:max_armor} a stack, and it never stops, no cap). Swinging a sword at it just hits the shield.

Poison ignores Armor. Stick it with a {item:poisoned_knife} and it bleeds no matter how thick the shield gets.
